name: Slicing Throw
description: Throw your weapon like a boomerang returning back to you dealing physical damage to monsters on its path. You can activate Daisy's Call to re-appear where the last thrown slicing throw is at any point in the flight.

subskills.name: Slicing Throw
subskills.description: Core of the Slicing Throw subtree.

subskills.name: Cut In Half
subskills.description: Increases the damage of slicing throw.

subskills.name: Precision Blade
subskills.description: Passively increases your dexterity.

subskills.name: One Swift Strike
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage and projectile speed of slicing throw.

subskills.name: Cuts and Wounds
subskills.description: Chance to inflict armor break on hit.

subskills.name: Splitting Chain
subskills.description: Chance to unleash an additional chaining blade on hit.

subskills.name: Burn the Corpses!
subskills.description: Chance to inflict burning on hit.

subskills.name: Daisy´s Insight
subskills.description: Reduced the cooldown of slicing throw.

subskills.name: Executioner's Apprentice
subskills.description: Slicing throw executes monsters below a threshold.

subskills.name: Bladestorm
subskills.description: Increases the size and spinning speed of slicing throw.

subskills.name: Bloody Combustion
subskills.description: Chance to unleash a ripple of blood from burning monsters on hit dealing additional damage.

subskills.name: Splitting blade
subskills.description: Slicing throw splits into multiple orbiting blades spiraling outwards and returning to the initial location.

subskills.name: Slicing Vortex
subskills.description: Slicing throw now orbits you with increased projectile speed and increased damage.

subskills.name: Bladesaw Massacre
subskills.description: Throw multiple blades forming a huge chainsaw that can be controlled. Slicing throw cooldown is now increased.

subskills.name: Daisy´s Regards
subskills.description: Slicing throw explodes into a fiery pentagram inflicting burning on hit.

name: Furious Strike
description: Perform a powerful area of effect attack dealing physical damage and infecting monsters struck with a stack of rabies. Each stack of rabies increases attack damage dealt to the monster.

subskills.name: Furious Strike
subskills.description: Core of the Furious Strike subtree.

subskills.name: Wide Spread Epidemic
subskills.description: Increases the power of rabies from furious strike.

subskills.name: Down with Sickness
subskills.description: Chance to inflict poison on hit.

subskills.name: Furious Reach
subskills.description: Increases the attack range of furious strike.

subskills.name: Strike of Hate
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by furious strike.

subskills.name: Blade Uppercut
subskills.description: Chance to slice monsters stunning and knocking them up dealing increased damage.

subskills.name: Serious Fever
subskills.description: Increases the maximum amount of rabies stacks.

subskills.name: Fueled Anger
subskills.description: Increases attack speed when using furious strike.

subskills.name: Mediocre Unit
subskills.description: Chance to spawn healing orbs from targets on hit when in holy form. Chance to unleash piercing enraged rats spreading rabies on hit when in unholy form.

subskills.name: Stay Still!
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned target.

subskills.name: Spread the Word
subskills.description: Chance to summon enraged flies on hit orbiting you and inflicting rabies.

subskills.name: Consumed by Hatred
subskills.description: Striking monsters with maximum stacks of rabies consumes them ripping and crushing the monster unleashing its bones in an arc behind it dealing damage according to the rabies stacks.

subskills.name: Flames of Fury
subskills.description: Striking a monster inflicted with rabies causes flaming cinders to fly around the target lightning the ground on fire. Striking a monster with maximum stacks of rabies additionally consumes the stacks unleashing a scorching nova inflicting burning on hit.

subskills.name: Sick to the Core
subskills.description: Increases the maximum stacks of rabies and damage dealt by furious strike.

subskills.name: The Absolute Unit
subskills.description: Striking a monster causes it to emmit fire damage based on your life replenish over time for a short duration on a radius around it when using holy form. Striking a monster unleashes impaling spikes dealing additional damage and a chance to replenish a portion of your maximum life on hit when using unholy form.

name: Holy Form
description: Activate Holy Form gaining increased life replenish and life steal at the cost of damage dealt. Any damage dealt while in this form is decreased.

name: Unholy Form
description: Activate Unholy Form gaining increased damage at the cost inflicting a portion of your max life as damage to your self every time you cast, attack or proc something. Any life replenish when in this form is lowered.

name: Sacrilegious Scorn
description: While in Holy Form gain increased attack speed and while in Unholy Form gain increased Critical damage.

name: Ending Fate
description: While in Holy Form gain increased base life regen after killing a monster and while in Unholy Form rip the monster apart after killing a monster causing huge area of effect damage.

name: Spiritual Duality
description: While in Holy Form increases your life Per Hit and while in Unholy Form increases your attack damage.

name: Awakening Fury
description: On hit gain a chance to increase your attack damage for a short duration.

name: Insatiable Hunger
description: Awaken the full potential of both holy and unholy to gain both benefits for a short period of time with increased effectiveness.

name: Chain Rip
description: Perform a powerful attack pulling all nearby monsters infront of you.

subskills.name: Chain Rip
subskills.description: Core of the Chain Rip subtree.

subskills.name: Ranged Suffering
subskills.description: Increases the range of chain rip.

subskills.name: Chains of Hatred
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by chain rip.

subskills.name: Torture the Skin
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Break the Flesh
subskills.description: Inflicts armor break on hit.

subskills.name: The Real Monster
subskills.description: Replenish a portion of your maximum life and maximum mana on hit.

subskills.name: Shift of Power
subskills.description: Decreases monster attack rating inflicting slow on hit.

subskills.name: Rocket Propelled Chains
subskills.description: Increases the projectile speed of chain rip.

subskills.name: Chains Unchained
subskills.description: Decreases the cooldown of chain rip.

subskills.name: Rage Trance
subskills.description: Gain increased damage reduction for a short duration when using chain rip.

subskills.name: They Never Know What Hit Them
subskills.description: Chance to stun targets on hit dealing increased damage to stunned targets.

subskills.name: Chains Attached
subskills.description: Increases the range and damage of chain rip greatly. Cooldown is increased.

subskills.name: Chainfueled Hunting
subskills.description: Rapidly throw multiple piercing chains in a cone towards target location dealing increased damage. Chain rip no longer pulls enemies.

subskills.name: Prey on the Weak
subskills.description: Chain rip stuns targets on hit buffing your and nearby allies damage to stunned targets for a short duration.

subskills.name: Carcass Rip
subskills.description: Chain rip chains into additional nearby monsters on hit pulling them towards the target.

name: Brutalizing Slash
description: Attack with brutalizing area of effect attack causing monsters to bleed.

subskills.name: Brutalizing Slash
subskills.description: Core of the Brutalizing Slash subtree.

subskills.name: Bucthering Skill
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using brutalizing slash.

subskills.name: Bonebreaker
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by brutalizing slash.

subskills.name: Unstoppable Rage
subskills.description: Decreases movement diminish when using brutalizing slash.

subskills.name: Descent to Madness
subskills.description: Increases attack speed when using brutalizing slash.

subskills.name: With 2 Hands
subskills.description: Chance on attack to unleash an additional brutalizing slash.

subskills.name: Skullsplitter
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage dealt by brutalizing slash.

subskills.name: Afterlife Burner
subskills.description: Chance on kill for the target to explode into a pile of corpses.

subskills.name: Precision Equals Power
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by brutalizing slash based on your dexterity.

subskills.name: For the Weak
subskills.description: Increases the attack range of brutalizing slash based on your strength.

subskills.name: Bleeding the Prey
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Pummeling Slashwave
subskills.description: Unleash a slash wave on attack inflicting increased bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Painmongering
subskills.description: Gain a stack of painmongering on hit increasing the tick frequency of bleed.

subskills.name: Gutting Frenzy
subskills.description: Chance to unleashes a ripple of blood on hit dealing increased critical damage based on your strength.

subskills.name: Meet Daisy
subskills.description: Every third attack unleashes daisy with increased damage and critical strike damage. The size of daisy is increased based on your missing life.

name: Fuel to Fire
description: Increase your damage dealt for a short period of time. Every corpse close to you will be siphoned for additional damage.

name: Hunger For Blood
description: Deal increased damage to bleeding targets.

name: Butchers Hook
description: Flail a huge meat hook around you gathering all monsters struck then pulling and stunning them infront of you.

subskills.name: Butchers Hook
subskills.description: Core of the Butchers Hook subtree.

subskills.name: Everlasting Anger
subskills.description: Increases the duration of butchers hook.

subskills.name: Backed by Rage
subskills.description: Increases the projectile speed of butchers hook.

subskills.name: Hook Discharge
subskills.description: Chance on cast to unleash an additional butchers hook.

subskills.name: Carcass Carrier
subskills.description: Increases the size of butchers hook.

subskills.name: Fresh Meat
subskills.description: Chance to inflict bleeding on hit.

subskills.name: Pierce the Torso
subskills.description: Chance to inflict armor break on hit.

subskills.name: Spin of Death
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by butchers hook.

subskills.name: Hellsent
subskills.description: Gain increased movement speed and phasing when using butchers hook.

subskills.name: Immaculate Butcher
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage dealt by butchers hook.

subskills.name: Bring the Carnage
subskills.description: Decreases the cooldown of butchers hook.

subskills.name: Concussive Blow
subskills.description: Butchers hook circles onces and slams into target location unleashing a corpse explosion with increased size and damage based on the amount of enemies captured in the hook.

subskills.name: Critical Velocity
subskills.description: Increases the velocity of butchers hook over time causing it to deal damage more frequently.

subskills.name: Master of Meat Hooks
subskills.description: Unleash multiple smaller hooks.

subskills.name: Welcome to Hell
subskills.description: Unleash butchers hook towards target location with increased range and damage returning back after a short duration. Butchers hook no longer has a cooldown.

name: Chain Swing
description: Throw a meat hook that pulls you into it when connecting with monster or environment. Additionally fires chains to nearby monsters when landing.

subskills.name: Chain Swing
subskills.description: Core of the Chain Swing subtree.

subskills.name: The Huntsman
subskills.description: Increases the projectile speed of chain swing.

subskills.name: Immobilizing Hit
subskills.description: Chance to stun targets on hit.

subskills.name: No Quarter
subskills.description: Reduces the mana cost of chain swing.

subskills.name: Demonic Chains
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by chain swing.

subskills.name: Introduce Fear
subskills.description: Pull monsters towards you from an increased radius after landing.

subskills.name: Physical Torture
subskills.description: Chance to inflict armor break on hit.

subskills.name: Killing Spree
subskills.description: Grants you a burst of attack speed after landing for a short duration.

subskills.name: Scent of Prey
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Entry Frenzy
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage dealt by chain swing.

subskills.name: Unblessed Path
subskills.description: Increases the maximum cast range. Chain swing now ignores terrain.

subskills.name: Warm Welcome
subskills.description: Unleash burning fissures at nearby monsters when landing inflicting burning.

subskills.name: Hookstorm
subskills.description: Swing hooks around while travelling dealing increased damage.

subskills.name: Prey of the Day
subskills.description: Connecting with a monster causes chain swing to pull all monsters nearby the target towards you.

subskills.name: Centrifugal Force
subskills.description: Chain swing maximum length is significantly shorter but can be targeted. Spin around the target ignoring collision. Monsters hit by the chain take increased damage on hit.

name: Submerged Knives
description: Smash the ground pushing waves of butchers knives out of the ground dealing massive damage and knocking them up. Deals extra damage to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Submerged Knives
subskills.description: Core of the Submerged Knives subtree.

subskills.name: Impaling Horde
subskills.description: Increases the amount of waves of submerged knives.

subskills.name: Agravating Wounds
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by submerged knives.

subskills.name: Sharp Edges
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using submerged knives.

subskills.name: Encased Cutters
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius of submerged knives.

subskills.name: Jugular Cut
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to stunned targets.

subskills.name: The Bigger They Are
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bosses when using submerged knives.

subskills.name: Blunt Cleaver
subskills.description: Chance to stun targets hit.

subskills.name: Extended Gutting
subskills.description: Increases the maximum cast range of submerged knives.

subskills.name: Nimble Handcraft
subskills.description: Reduces the cooldown of submerged knives.

subskills.name: Meat Skewer
subskills.description: Chance to impale targets on hit dealing damage over time.

subskills.name: Tidal Knives
subskills.description: Unleash a shockwave of submerged knives towards target location.

subskills.name: Sudden Chaining
subskills.description: Chance to unleash chains towards target on hit dealing additional damage.

subskills.name: Knifehoarder
subskills.description: Submerged knives can be activated/deactivated. While active periodically unleash submerged knives at nearby monsters inflicting bleeding. Drains a portion of your maximum mana while active.

subskills.name: Bone Daggers
subskills.description: Consume corpses hit by submerged knives unleashing piercing gutting knives towards nearby monsters.

name: Enraged Mania
description: Increase attack area of effect range and attack speed.

name: Blender
description: Swing two huge butchers knives around you dealing physical damage.

subskills.name: Blender
subskills.description: Core of the Blender subtree.

subskills.name: Sharpened Cleavers
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by blender.

subskills.name: Industrial Sized
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius of blender.

subskills.name: No Bits Nor Pieces
subskills.description: Increases attack rating when using blender.

subskills.name: Ragefueled Energy
subskills.description: Increases the duration of blender.

subskills.name: Extra Cleaver Addon
subskills.description: Increases the amount of blades on blender.

subskills.name: Obsidian Blades
subskills.description: Increases the critical strike damage dealt by blender.

subskills.name: Attachment Malfunction
subskills.description: Chance to send blades towards target on hit briefly returning back to you.

subskills.name: It Will Blend
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to bleeding targets.

subskills.name: Blood Thirsting Killing Machine
subskills.description: Chance to gain a stack of blood thirst on hit increasing your movement speed for a short duration.

subskills.name: Will it Blend?
subskills.description: Knock monsters back dealing increased damage and slowing them.

subskills.name: A.I. Empowered Nanoblenders
subskills.description: Summon multiple small blenders orbiting around you.

subskills.name: Blenderang
subskills.description: Throw a traveling blender towards target location returning back to you shortly. Blender cooldown is reduced.

subskills.name: Attachable Microblades
subskills.description: Chance to conjure a small blender at target location on hit dealing additional damage for a short duration.

subskills.name: Blending Blood Pact
subskills.description: Blender gains increased damage but killing monsters drains a portion of your maximum life. This effect is non-lethal and will de-activate blender if you cannot sacrifice your life anymore.
